caption: The drawing features a beige background with two prominent objects: a large, abstract floral design and a sketch of a ceramic jar. The floral design is situated in the lower center of the page, composed of three blue stylized flowers with elongated petals and leaves, and thin curving stems. Clustered dots, also in blue, radiate outward from the central area of the flowers, creating a pattern of movement. Above this design, there is a simple line drawing of a jar, oriented upright. The jar is outlined in blue and contains a small, similar blue floral motif in the center, mirroring the larger floral design below. The top of the jar features an inscription that reads "D. L. P. Norton BENNINGTON VT" along with a small symbol. The overall color scheme is monochromatic, primarily using shades of blue on a neutral beige background, with the flower and jar forming the main elements of the composition.
title: Churn
